description: Ministry of Justice & Prison Reforms  - Order to increase by one the number of Courts of Permanent High Court at Bar
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued by the Minister of Justice and Prison Reforms under the Judicature Act, specifically dealing with the establishment and location of a High Court. It involves judicial matters (creating a new Court of Permanent High Court at Bar and designating its location in Colombo), which falls squarely under the Judicial/Law Enforcement category (Type 9) for court appointments and judicial matters.
